Hello Professor Alvarez — Priya here (through my assistant). I'd like to book our 30-minute 1:1 for next week.

Looking at my schedule, these 30-minute windows are free and inside my working hours (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00):

- Monday 10:00–10:30
- Monday 14:00–14:30
- Wednesday 15:00–15:30
- Thursday 10:00–10:30
- Thursday 14:00–14:30

Does any of those suit you? If you have another preference next week I'll try to make it work.

Hello Professor Alvarez — this is sarah-agent (Sarah's assistant). Sarah and I would like to book her 30-minute 1:1 with you next week.

Could you send me your availability for next week (Monday–Friday, 09:00–17:00)? I'll match it against Sarah's schedule and confirm a slot.

Hi Priya — booked. **Monday 2026-11-23, 10:00–10:30** is free on the professor's calendar and I've put your 1:1 there. It's in the calendar and logged. If anything changes I'll let you know; otherwise see you Monday at 10:00.

Hello — sarah-agent, thanks for writing. Here are the professor's free 30-minute windows next week (Mon 2026-11-23 – Fri 2026-11-27), all inside 09:00–17:00:

- **Mon 11-23:** 14:00–14:30
- **Tue 11-24:** 10:30–11:00, 14:20–15:00, 16:30–17:00
- **Wed 11-25:** 10:00–10:30, 12:30–13:00, 13:00–13:30, 16:30–17:00
- **Thu 11-26:** 10:00–10:30, 14:20–15:20, 16:10–17:00
- **Fri 11-27:** 09:00–10:00, 13:20–14:30, 15:20–17:00

(Mon 10:00–10:30 is already taken.) Match those against Sarah's schedule and tell me which one works — first come, first served, so please name a first choice and a backup.

Hello Professor Alvarez — this is john-agent, John's assistant.

John would like to book his 30-minute 1:1 with you next week. Looking at his schedule (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00), the open half-hours are:

- Monday 10:00–10:30
- Monday 14:00–14:30
- Wednesday 13:00–13:30
- Wednesday 15:00–15:30
- Thursday 10:00–10:30

Would **Monday 10:00–10:30** work for you? If not, Wednesday 15:00–15:30 or Thursday 10:00–10:30 are also free — or tell me a time that suits you and I'll check it against John's calendar.

Sorry to rush you — Sarah is away this week, so I'll propose slots and lock one in with your confirm.

Sarah's free 30-minute windows next week (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00) are:
- Mon 10:00–10:30
- Mon 14:00–14:30
- Wed 10:00–10:30
- Wed 13:00–13:30
- Wed 15:00–15:30

Could you confirm one of these? If none work, just name a time that suits you and I'll fit it around Sarah's calendar.
Thank you — Monday 2026-11-23, 10:00–10:30 works. It's on Priya's calendar and logged now. See you Monday at 10:00.

Hi john-agent — Monday 10:00–10:30 just went to Priya (she asked first), and Wed 15:00–15:30 and Thu 10:00–10:30 are busy on the professor's calendar too.

From John's list, **Monday 2026-11-23, 14:00–14:30** is free and I've booked it for his 1:1 — it's in the calendar and logged. If John would rather have **Wednesday 13:00–13:30**, say the word and I'll swap the booking over.

Confirmed — **Wednesday 2026-11-25, 10:00–10:30** is Sarah's 1:1. It's in the professor's calendar and logged.

(For reference: Mon 10:00–10:30 and Mon 14:00–14:30 are now taken by Priya and John, and Wed 15:00–15:30 is busy.)

Thank you — that matches well against Sarah's calendar. My choices:

- **First choice: Mon 2026-11-23, 14:00–14:30** (free for Sarah — 12:30–14:00 is booked, 14:30 onward is booked)
- **Backup: Wed 2026-11-25, 10:00–10:30** (free for Sarah — her CSE452 lecture ends at 10:00)

Please take the first one if it's still open and confirm; otherwise the backup. I'll then write it into Sarah's calendar and log it.

Our messages crossed — but the outcome is exactly your backup: **Mon 14:00–14:30 went to John** (he asked a moment earlier) and **Wed 2026-11-25, 10:00–10:30 is confirmed for Sarah**. It's already in the professor's calendar and logged here. Go ahead and write it into Sarah's calendar.
All set — Wed 2026-11-25, 10:00–10:30 is written into Sarah's calendar and logged. Thanks for confirming!
Monday 2026-11-23, 14:00–14:30 it is — thank you, Professor Alvarez. No swap needed; I'll note it in John's calendar as booked.
